# Subway Seat for Glow

A Glamour style: top-level headings as orange station signs, the rest stepping down the stripe from orange to sage, and code blocks colored like the editor ports.

[Glow](https://github.com/charmbracelet/glow) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/glow/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.json`](subway-seat.json) | `~/.config/glamour/subway-seat.json` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.json`](subway-seat-tunnel.json) | `~/.config/glamour/subway-seat-tunnel.json` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.json`](subway-seat-enamel.json) | `~/.config/glamour/subway-seat-enamel.json` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in config.fish (GLAMOUR_STYLE also reaches gh and other Glamour apps):

```fish
set -Ux GLAMOUR_STYLE ~/.config/glamour/subway-seat.json
set -Ux GLOW_STYLE $GLAMOUR_STYLE
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in config.fish (GLAMOUR_STYLE also reaches gh and other Glamour apps):

```fish
set -Ux GLAMOUR_STYLE ~/.config/glamour/subway-seat-tunnel.json
set -Ux GLOW_STYLE $GLAMOUR_STYLE
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in config.fish (GLAMOUR_STYLE also reaches gh and other Glamour apps):

```fish
set -Ux GLAMOUR_STYLE ~/.config/glamour/subway-seat-enamel.json
set -Ux GLOW_STYLE $GLAMOUR_STYLE
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/glamour/subway-seat.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/glamour/subway-seat-tunnel.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/glamour/subway-seat-enamel.json`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
